meta.title: Business Plan | Elleva
meta.description: The Elleva business plan: autonomous AI infrastructure for the financial market, the client back office, the Elleva Partners program, the E1–E5 partner framework and contract acceleration.

whatIs.title: We are an infrastructure startup of autonomous AI agents for the financial market.
whatIs.p1: A new technological layer between capital and financial institutions.
whatIs.p2: It is financial technology that brings intelligence and scale to capital management.
whatIs.p3Accent: Just as the cloud became infrastructure for companies,
whatIs.p3: Elleva was created to be infrastructure for capital.

market.title: More capital demands more technology
market.lead: The autonomous layer between capital and the global financial system.
market.text: Elleva is not a broker, nor a fund, nor a signals platform. It is the AI infrastructure that connects data, mandates, compliance and execution on top of financial institutions that already exist.

framework.text: Elleva has five levels of commercial development.

levels.title: Executive Partner

grow.title: Grow your portfolio.
grow.textBefore: The bigger and more consistent your portfolio, the higher your level
grow.textAccent: of expansion of your client portfolio and of market building

diversification.title: Growing also means distributing.
diversification.text: For a portfolio to be considered healthy for qualification purposes, its volume must not depend excessively on a single origin.

rule.title: Maximum portfolio concentration
rule.text: No Portfolio Segment may represent more than 50% of the eligible volume used for qualification.
rule.exampleLine1: For an eligible portfolio of: US$ 100,000
rule.exampleLine2: a single segment may contribute at most: US$ 50,000
rule.exampleClosing: The remaining US$ 50,000 must come from other eligible segments.

acceleration.title: Elleva Partners
acceleration.lead: Developing clients does not create a parallel commission.
acceleration.text: In Elleva Partners, eligible commercial activity can generate a benefit applied to the Partner's own contract.

steps.title: Commercial activity
steps.text: The Partner develops new clients and generates eligible commercial activity.

steps.title: Applied benefit
steps.text: The result of that activity is converted into a benefit within the Partner's own contract.

steps.title: Contract acceleration
steps.text: That benefit accelerates the progression of the contract the Partner already holds with Elleva.

steps.title: More results
steps.text: You grow, your contract advances and your potential grows too.

acceleration.closingBefore: Instead of creating a second, separate commission balance,
acceleration.closingAccent: commercial activity can accelerate the progression of the contract
acceleration.closingAfter: the Partner already holds with Elleva.
